name: settings
title: Settings
description: Available connections and the connections used by your apps.

operations.name: open
operations.description: Compose the settings surface and answer the preferences.

operations.name: refresh-connections
operations.description: Refresh and return this brain’s credential-free connection summaries and installed app bindings.

operations.name: save-preferences
operations.description: Save DisplayName and Theme with the Baseline snapshot from preferences/baseline. Reject stale drafts and preserve invalid drafts.

operations.name: reload-preferences
operations.description: Discard editable drafts and load the stored preferences.

operations.name: reconcile-preferences
operations.description: Refresh clean drafts from stored preferences; retain unsaved edits and report conflicts.
